videos.title: iPhone Duo hands-on
videos.description: The first foldable iPhone is finally here, and we got the chance to try the iPhone Duo for ourselves. The Verge’s editor-in-chief Nilay Patel takes a closer look at the foldable, which has a 5.4-inch display but opens to a 7.6-inch panel. Apple went with a matte finish with the Duo’s inner screen which helps with glare, but also helps mask the crease. videos.title: Hands-on with Apple's new watches
videos.description:
The Verge’s senior reviewer Victoria Song got some hands-on time with Apple’s latest watches. The Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 have some new Siri AI features and the return of ceramic cases. The Live Rewind and Siri Recap features will be available in beta later this year on both the Watch Series 12 and Watch Ultra 4, in English at first. Do you plan to upgrade? videos.title: iPhone Duo Event in 24 minutes
videos.description: Apple just wrapped up its ‘Surprise and Shine’ event, unveiling its long-anticipated foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo. It starts from $1,999 for 256GB of storage, with the option to go up to 2TB total. We also got a look at the new iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, which have a new A20 Pro chip and purportedly the longest battery in an iPhone.
